title: Just Added a My Career Mode to my Football Game! Create Your Own Superstar!
author: Ordinary-Tutor-5556
selftext:
Turbo Tackle's new My Career mode lets you create your own quarterback and play his last college drive. Then you get drafted, fight for the starting job and play through up to 18 seasons. You deal with press conferences, brand deals, contract holdouts and rival QBs, and eventually retirement and the Hall of Fame vote. It’s in beta, so there will be rough edges. Every My Career screen has a Send Feedback button and I read everything that comes in. Mainly made for laptops as of now.

Free game created with AI.

Feedback is welcomed!

[https://turbotackle.app/](https://turbotackle.app/)

replies.author: agardner26
replies.body:
I played a bit while on my flight just now! loved the cutscenes lol. Might be fun to expand on character creation:

Some of my suggestions

More control over starting attribute distribution (only 3 archetype options rn)

More college options (not just the top colleges, but maybe going to a small one, being a late round draft pick. Or leading a small college to the championship). Maybe one full college season before pros?

My personal preference is a more random potential/overall growth system (my games use these, inspired by the goat pre-AI web browser game play.basketball-gm.com), rather than the “play games then spend points to improve” so you can have the overall/potential change year to year. Maybe one choice per year on how to practice and what to work on.

Overall it had a lot of character and was pretty fun! Some performance lag while playing the actual games though. (Iphone 16)

replies.author: Ordinary-Tutor-5556
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback! Would def look to expand more on attribute distribution. I would love to add more colleges, but since it's only one college game, doesn't really make sense to right now. In the future, I'd even want to have a whole college career before the pro one which at that point I'd have a lot of college options. Will def look into the growth options. Will def improve the game and thanks for the feedback lmk if there's anything else!!
